methods.title: Docker
methods.detail: One command, on any machine with Docker.

steps.text: Install Docker on the machine that will run the server.
Copy its fingerprint: the line Certificate SHA-256.
Open its console. Paste there the pair command 1loop shows next, then leave with Ctrl+P, Ctrl+Q.

methods.title: Docker Compose
methods.detail: A compose.yml file, if you manage your services with it.

steps.text: Install Docker on the machine that will run the server.
In an empty folder, save this as compose.yml.
steps.command:
services:
  server:
    image: ghcr.io/feur-inc/1loop-server:alpha
    container_name: 1loop-server
    restart: unless-stopped
    stdin_open: true
    tty: true
    ports:
      - "47101:47101"
    volumes:
      - data:/data
      - ./projects:/projects
volumes:
  data:

steps.text: Copy its fingerprint: the line Certificate SHA-256.
Open its console. Paste there the pair command 1loop shows next, then leave with Ctrl+P, Ctrl+Q.
Download 1loop-server-…-linux-amd64 from the newest release (the first one listed).
Install Git (here on Debian or Ubuntu).
In the download folder, start it. Keep this terminal open.
Copy its fingerprint: the line Certificate SHA-256 it prints. Paste in this terminal the pair command 1loop shows next.

methods.title: Windows program
methods.detail: The server alone, on a Windows PC.

steps.text: Download 1loop-server-…-windows-amd64.exe from the newest release (the first one listed).
In PowerShell, in the download folder, start it. Allow it when Windows asks about the network. Keep this window open.
Copy its fingerprint: the line Certificate SHA-256 it prints. Paste in this window the pair command 1loop shows next.
